title: Jagged, Peppery Argentinian Chicken Empanada
description: A hearty and flavorful empanada dish from Argentina, featuring a post-workout boost with a dairy-free twist. The peppery kick from the ají amarillo peppers will keep you coming back for more!
instructions: In a pan over medium heat, cook the lardons until crispy, then set aside.
Sauté the onion and garlic in a pan over medium heat until softened.
Add the ají amarillo peppers and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the chicken breast and cook until browned, then set aside.
In a large bowl, combine the flour, salt, and pepper.
Add the egg and milk to the flour mixture and mix until a dough forms.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll out each piece into a circle.
Place a spoonful of the chicken mixture onto one half of each circle, then fold the other half over and press the edges together.
Brush the tops with egg wash and sprinkle with salt.
Bake the empanadas for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
